organization: Parmelin family farm and vineyard, Bursins (Vaud)
description: Ran the family agricultural and viticultural business at Bursins, taken over jointly with his brother Christophe Parmelin. He gave up active management on becoming a Federal Councillor.

role: President of the general council (communal legislature)
description: First elected office; presided over the communal general council of Bursins.

role: Member of the Grand Council of Vaud (cantonal deputy)
organization: Grand Council of the Canton of Vaud
description: Served as a cantonal deputy for the SVP/UDC in the Vaud cantonal parliament.

organization: Swiss People's Party (SVP/UDC), Vaud cantonal section
description: Led the Vaud cantonal branch of the SVP/UDC; previously vice-president and section president for the Rolle district.
Represented the canton of Vaud in the lower chamber. Sat on the Social Security and Public Health Committee (chair 2013-2015) and from 2007 on the Environment, Spatial Planning and Energy Committee.

role: Federal Councillor, Head of the Department of Defence, Civil Protection and Sport (DDPS)
description: Took over the defence department from Ueli Maurer; led the relaunch of the fighter-jet procurement programme after the 2014 Gripen referendum failure.

role: Federal Councillor, Head of the Department of Economic Affairs, Education and Research (EAER/DEFR)
description: Succeeded Johann Schneider-Ammann at the economics department; portfolio includes economic policy, agriculture, free-trade agreements, vocational and higher education and research, and EU relations.

Serving his second term as President of the Confederation (first in 2021); also Vice President in 2020 and 2025. The presidency is a primus inter pares role rotating annually among Federal Councillors.
